title: Cool classmate girls 10 years later
description:
“Having you sit next to me is... depressing. Don’t talk to me.”
Himuro Kuru—When I first met her in high school, she was an extremely cool, beautiful honor student who wouldn’t let anyone get close to her. But now…
“Hey, hey. Is it okay if I… stay this close to you today?”
Sakuragi Kuru—Ten years later, she’s married to me, Sakuragi Susumu, and she has become a cute girl who wants to be lovey-dovey with me every day!?
At school, on dates… every time she actively gets closer to me, her cold heart begins to melt…
author: Amane Megumi, Komano Mako, Kyutai X
